title: Ibn Battuta: Travels in Asia and Africa, selected account of Taghaza
version: H. A. R. Gibb translation and edition (1929), Taghaza account, pp. 317–323
lineage: Fordham republishes selected passages from Gibb’s 1929 English translation of Ibn Battuta’s retrospective travel narrative; brief evidence notes paraphrase the inspected selection.

passages.note: Ibn Battuta describes reaching Taghaza after a 1352 departure, rock salt extracted in slabs by enslaved workers under Massufa ownership, imported food, and prices of eight to ten mithqals per salt load at Iwalatan. The translated travel narrative is retrospective and its price is a reported local figure.
